diff --git a/test/units/modules/test_unarchive.py b/test/units/modules/test_unarchive.py
index e66d0a1..b9bb003 100644
--- a/test/units/modules/test_unarchive.py
+++ b/test/units/modules/test_unarchive.py
@@ -1,5 +1,9 @@
 from __future__ import annotations
 
+import binascii
+import datetime
+import os
+import time
 
 import pytest
 
@@ -18,6 +22,49 @@ class FakeAnsibleModule:
 
 
 class TestCaseZipArchive:
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
+        'timestamp, expected', (
+            ('19800101.000000', datetime.datetime(1980, 1, 1).timetuple()),
+            ('21071231.235959', datetime.datetime(2107, 12, 31, 23, 59, 59).timetuple()),
+            ('20000229.123456', datetime.datetime(2000, 2, 29, 12, 34, 56).timetuple()),
+            ('19800000.000000', (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)),
+            ('19791231.235959', (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)),
+            ('21080101.000000', (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)),
+            ('20230229.120000', (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)),
+            ('20231301.000000', (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)),
+            ('20230101.246000', (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)),
+            ('20230101-000000', (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)),
+        )
+    )
+    def test_valid_time_stamp(self, timestamp, expected, fake_ansible_module):
+        fake_ansible_module.params = {
+            'extra_opts': '', 'exclude': [], 'include': [], 'io_buffer_size': 65536,
+        }
+        archive = ZipArchive('', b'', {}, fake_ansible_module)
+        assert archive._valid_time_stamp(timestamp) == expected
+
+    def test_invalid_zip_timestamp_for_existing_file(self, mocker, fake_ansible_module, tmp_path):
+        file_path = tmp_path / 'file.txt'
+        file_path.write_bytes(b'content')
+        epoch = time.mktime((1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0))
+        os.utime(file_path, (epoch, epoch))
+
+        fake_ansible_module.params = {
+            'extra_opts': '', 'exclude': [], 'include': [],
+            'io_buffer_size': 65536, 'keep_newer': False,
+        }
+        fake_ansible_module.run_command = mocker.Mock(return_value=(
+            0, '-rw-r--r--  1.0 unx        7 tx defN 19800000.000000 file.txt\n', ''
+        ))
+        fake_ansible_module.debug = mocker.Mock()
+        archive = ZipArchive('', os.fsencode(tmp_path), {'owner': None, 'group': None, 'mode': None}, fake_ansible_module)
+        mocker.patch.object(archive, '_crc32', return_value=binascii.crc32(b'content'))
+
+        result = archive.is_unarchived()
+
+        assert result['unarchived'] is True
+        assert archive.includes == []
+
     @pytest.mark.parametrize(
         'side_effect, expected_reason', (
             ([ValueError, '/bin/zipinfo'], "Unable to find required 'unzip'"),
